title: Failure Types & Recovery
summary: Apply orchestration patterns, configure parallel isolation, detect and resolve conflicts, manage agent lifecycles, and implement recovery in multi-agent workflows.

rows: Diagnose → retry if transient → escalate if persistent
Completed N of M steps then stopped
Checkpoint completed work → resume only failed portion

blocks.text: **Human-in-the-Loop Recovery:** High-risk or ambiguous failures → halt execution → route to human → human authorizes → pipeline resumes. Escalation of last resort for safety-critical decisions.
